description: Reply envelope for registry.admin.> (A3b, td-efea19): {v, ok, result?} or {v, ok, error:{code,message?}}. Not a signed A7b artifact; the command is signed, the reply is not.

cases.name: ok_no_result
cases.description: A successful command with no value (set_mode, suspend_host, ...).

cases.name: ok_with_result
cases.description: A successful read (list_hosts/read_audit_log); result is an opaque CBOR value.

cases.name: refused_code_only
cases.description: A replay refusal: the code is the machine-readable reason and no human detail is added.

cases.name: refused_code_and_message
cases.description: A malformed-argument refusal with a human-readable detail.
